description.summary: This table details the timeframes for various actions related to claim processing, as outlined in the 'יישוב תביעות וטיפול בפניות הציבור' circular. It specifies the number of business days required for actions like providing policy copies or claim status updates.

טבלה: מועדי טיפול בתביעות
This table details the timeframes for various actions related to claim processing, as outlined in the 'יישוב תביעות וטיפול בפניות הציבור' circular. It specifies the number of business days required for actions like providing policy copies or claim status updates.
ממדים: type of action / request, timeframe (business days)
